cases.scenario: The user explicitly requests a Meta-O Orca deep review with one full SHA, intent, scope and two approved vendor-diverse selections. Four otherwise identical proven failures carry emergency-wide, high-impact reachable, bounded operational and local robustness prerequisites. The project is registered as a folder and offers no isolated worktree.
must: under §A-SESSION-01 prove same-project placement before creating exactly two independent vendor-diverse reviewers
under §A-REVIEW-04 emit the full canonical Review-Execution response with required evidence sections and classify the four proven failures as textual P0, P1, P2 and P3
under §A-RESPONSE-03 atomically hand both unchanged payloads to the named consumer and wait for exact acknowledgement before cleanup

under §A-SESSION-01 prefer two isolated worktrees and, when the registration offers none, review read-only in the exact existing project workspace with the brief's exact SHA carrying candidate identity
mustNot: share peer report bytes or confidence-score severity
create a subagent, executor, verifier or project registration
add a repository registration or leave the shared checkout changed to obtain isolation

cases.scenario: The user makes a generic review request outside the Meta-O lifecycle and supplies no opaque Review-Execution id. A second request names the lifecycle correctly, but the project has a `MO-BACKLOG/1` command and no papercut document or identifier-history gate, and the knowledge-layer helper prints `Knowledge-Layer: state=needs_attention reason=partial_signals`.
must: avoid implicit Meta-O activation under §A-ACTIVATION-01 and report that the portable header cannot be fabricated
under §A-MEMORY-05 take the state from the helper on the exact SHA and never send a brief without its literal Knowledge-Layer line
under §A-BACKLOG-01 return needs_attention naming each missing readiness signal and leave running the setup skill to the human
mustNot: change model configuration or invent an execution id
start the pair against an unready project or prepare it

cases.scenario: A follow_up request lacks the reviewer's own prior report and computable prior-SHA delta; the reachable diff also exposes a trust-boundary change requiring deep coverage.
must: under §A-DELIVERY-01 return UNKNOWN for missing follow-up context and name each missing input
under §A-REVIEW-04 record requested=follow_up effective=deep when the context is later supplied
retain a non-empty Unknown-Account and exact end marker
under §A-DELIVERY-01 refuse task-byte injection while the terminal envelope reports a non-empty composer draft
mustNot: deliver a shortened follow-up PASS or silently substitute a model

cases.scenario: The first deep pair returned valid FINDINGS on the previous candidate. The executor fixed them and handed over a new full candidate SHA. Both reviewer slots are the same provider sessions, each 20 minutes past its last worker_done, and `scripts/mo-harness-screen.mjs` answers `action=inject` for both. The coordinator is tempted to start a fresh deep pair on the new SHA because the SHA changed.
must: under §A-SESSION-01 decide each slot with `scripts/mo-review-resource.mjs hot` and keep both hot slots, binding the next Dispatch to the same session
under §A-REVIEW-02 send `follow_up` to the same pair with only each reviewer's own prior reports and dispositions, and count it as one attempt
mustNot: start a new deep pair only because the candidate SHA changed
release or close either reviewer session between the FINDINGS and the follow-up

cases.scenario: Two idle reviewer sessions are about to receive a Dispatch. The Claude screen shows a rule above `❯` holding the painted suggestion `Try "refactor Makefile"`, and Orca's envelope `draft` carries user-typed bytes. The Codex screen shows an empty `›` row above a narrow footer whose context segment reads `Context …`.
must: under §A-DELIVERY-01 deliver only after `scripts/mo-harness-screen.mjs` answers `action=inject` for a proven empty composer
under §A-DELIVERY-01 treat the Claude suggestion and the non-empty draft as `refuse`, close nothing else, and return needs_attention for that slot
under §A-DELIVERY-01 recognize the Codex composer with `Context …` as idle and record `context=unknown`
mustNot: erase, overwrite or append to composer text to make room for the task
treat a painted suggestion as an empty composer
